question: Should OpenClaw adopt the narrow `openclaw commands` catalog, and which command identity, schema fields, plugin metadata, and Gateway/node relationships are stable commitments?
rationale: The linked implementation demonstrates feasibility, but these choices create public operator and plugin compatibility expectations that implementation evidence cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt narrow catalog
options.body: Approve list and exact inspection with a minimal versioned schema and source-owned optional metadata.

options.title: Adopt broader catalog
options.body: Choose the wider catalog namespace and operational lenses before accepting any permanent contract.

options.title: Decline a shared catalog
options.body: Improve existing CLI, Gateway, plugin, and node discovery independently without adding a normalized public inventory.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow catalog
recommendation.body: Approve list and exact inspection with a minimal versioned schema and source-owned optional metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the lifecycle governing acceptance and are the strongest available routing candidate for the required RFC-process decision.
